source_name: ПриватБанк — Статистична звітність (за НПА НБУ)
why_relevant: Regulatory statistical reporting mandated by NBU acts — structured periodic financial data complementing the narrative annual report.

source_name: Ощадбанк — Звітність емітента цінних паперів
why_relevant: Oschadbank's securities-issuer disclosure page — the statutory IR channel for a bank that has issued eurobonds/LPNs; annual and interim issuer information.

source_name: Ощадбанк — Показники діяльності
why_relevant: Performance-indicators page: periodic KPI/financial results of the #2 Ukrainian bank by assets, useful for time-series tracking without parsing full IFRS PDFs.

source_name: Oschadbank — News (English)
why_relevant: English press-release feed carrying annual-report publication announcements, audit confirmations (EY), IFI deals — the de facto investor communication line in English.

source_name: Ощадбанк — Про банк / About bank (EN)
why_relevant: English corporate section — entry point to governance, ratings and report links for foreign investors and IFI counterparties.

source_name: Укргазбанк — Річна фінансова звітність за МСФЗ (аудиторський звіт)
why_relevant: Canonical annual IFRS statements + audit opinions of the ~95% state-owned Ukrgasbank, the bank furthest along the privatisation track (IFC convertible loan).

source_name: Укргазбанк — Проміжна фінансова звітність за МСФЗ
why_relevant: Quarterly/interim IFRS statements — highest-frequency hard-numbers feed for this issuer, valuable for tracking wartime performance and privatisation readiness.

source_name: Укргазбанк — Регулярна інформація емітента
why_relevant: Statutory issuer disclosure index (річна інформація емітента) — governance, share capital, related-party and bond-issue facts not present in the IFRS pack.

source_name: Sense Bank — official site (sensebank.ua), reporting/uploads area
why_relevant: Nationalised (July 2023) systemically important bank now on the privatisation list; its own site is the primary disclosure venue, with statutory reporting files served from an /uploads/ path.

source_name: Міністерство фінансів України — Звіти по державних банках (фінансові)
why_relevant: The shareholder ministry aggregates financial reporting for all four state banks in one place — a single pointer hub that also hosts copies of the banks' annual reports and monthly performance decks.

source_name: SMIDA (АРІФРУ) — база розкриття інформації емітентів
why_relevant: National securities-market disclosure database: statutory annual/quarterly issuer filings and corporate-governance reports for PrivatBank, Oschadbank, Ukrgasbank and Sense Bank — structured, machine-readable (XML forms available), and independent of bank websites.

source_name: Cbonds — Oschadbank issuer & bond pages
why_relevant: Third-party bond database with Oschadbank issuer identifiers (LEI 254900A6T6YMJ08HT755, ISIN XS1273034444), eurobond terms, ratings and restructuring history — the only structured view of state-bank eurobond/LPN disclosure.

source_name: Мінфін (minfin.com.ua) — новини про звітність держбанків
why_relevant: High-frequency Ukrainian financial news portal that reliably reports the publication of state-bank annual/IFRS reports with headline figures — useful as a change-detection tripwire and for cross-checking numbers.

source_name: Clarity Project — корпоративні дані АТ «СЕНС БАНК» (ЄДРПОУ 23494714)
why_relevant: Aggregator of Ukrainian registry data (EDR, filings, tenders, beneficiaries) — resolves legal identity, ownership changes post-nationalisation and links to statutory filings for the state banks.

source_name: Bankografo+ — портрет банку (Сенс Банк та ін.)
why_relevant: Ukrainian bank-analytics portal presenting per-bank normalised financials — a cross-check layer when issuer PDFs are hard to parse; note legacy 'alfa-bank' slug for Sense Bank reflects the pre-rebrand identity.

source_name: Асоціація ЄМА (Українська міжбанківська асоціація членів платіжних систем) — Члени
why_relevant: Single densest enumeration of the Ukrainian payments population: card schemes (Visa, Mastercard), ~40 banks, PSPs/fintechs (NovaPay, Platon, EasyPay, iPay.ua, RozetkaPay, PayForce, Payoneer, monobank, A-Bank), marketplaces (OLX, Prom.ua) and the credit bureau UBKI. Each entry is a logo+link, so it snowballs directly into corporate sites and their IR/press pages.

source_name: Асоціація ЄМА — Новини / дайджести платіжного ринку
why_relevant: Rolling news stream that republishes member press releases and announces new members/premium partners (e.g. Payoneer, RozetkaPay, Prom.ua joining). Also carries recurring 'Новини платіжного ринку від ЄМА' digests — a low-cost proxy feed for payments-sector announcements.

source_name: Асоціація ЄМА — аналітичні звіти (Матриця/Дайджест платіжного шахрайства)
why_relevant: ЄМА publishes recurring sector-aggregate analytics on payment fraud, card volumes and open banking/SCA readiness — a rare non-regulator aggregate view of the UA payments market, useful as baseline market sizing and risk context.

source_name: Асоціація українських банків (АУБ) — Члени АУБ
why_relevant: Oldest UA banking association (est. 1990); membership reported at 70–125 institutions including state, commercial and non-bank financial companies. The members page is the pointer index into individual bank sites and their disclosure/IR pages.

source_name: АУБ — Аналітика та показники діяльності банків (incl. Power BI dashboard)
why_relevant: Association-compiled banking-system aggregates and per-bank activity indicators, including an interactive Power BI dashboard — a structured, repeatable numeric series independent of (though derived from) NBU data, useful for sizing and ranking banks.

source_name: АУБ — Новини АУБ / банківські новини / новини партнерів
why_relevant: Three parallel feeds — association news, banking-sector news and explicitly 'partner news' (member press releases). The partner-news category is effectively a syndicated bank press-release stream.

source_name: НАБУ — Незалежна/Національна асоціація банків України (офіційний сайт)
why_relevant: Association whose member banks are stated to hold >95% of Ukrainian banking-system assets; the natural authoritative membership roster for the banking side of the cell, plus 11 sector committees whose outputs signal regulatory and market agenda.

source_name: УАФІК / UAFIC — Українська асоціація фінтех та інноваційних компаній
why_relevant: The membership hub for Ukrainian fintechs — the layer of actors (PSPs, lenders, wallets, infrastructure) that never appear in bank registries. Member list plus news feed give both the actor population and their announcements. English mirror exists at /en.

source_name: УАФІК — Каталог фінтех-компаній України (annual fintech catalogue/research)
why_relevant: The flagship annual UAFIC study: a full catalogue of Ukrainian fintech companies plus survey-based market statistics (2025 edition surveyed ~150 market participants; produced with NBU, Ministry of Digital Transformation, IFC, SECO, GGF, Ukrainian Startup Fund). It is simultaneously a company roster and a market-sizing document — the highest-value single artefact in this cell.

source_name: УКБС — Український кредитно-банківський союз
why_relevant: Third national banking association (est. 1994 as Kyiv Banking Union, renamed 2005), reported to unite ~92 financial-credit institutions plus representative offices of foreign financial institutions — including smaller regional banks and non-bank lenders that the larger associations may omit.

source_name: ВАФК — Всеукраїнська асоціація фінансових компаній: Учасники Асоціації
why_relevant: Membership roster of non-bank financial companies (finance companies, microlenders, payment-adjacent FIs), split into full and associate members. Captures the long tail of licensed financial companies that never surface in bank-focused sources.

source_name: ВАКС — Всеукраїнська асоціація кредитних спілок: розділ members
why_relevant: Credit-union membership directory with per-member pages (observed URL pattern /members/<id>/). Credit unions are deposit-taking, card-issuing-adjacent actors and part of the retail financial-services population; also a natural target base for POS/payment infrastructure.
